Marisa: Heads-up — product asked for a new runtime-health dashboard that mixes infra metrics (GPU util, qps) with routing-policy metrics (fallback counts, model swaps). Need input on what to expose to customers vs internal. Quick sync? 10–15m?
Sam: +1. We should separate customer-facing panels from internal ones. Also how do we surface quotas/reserved capacity per tenant without leaking infra topology?
Devin: From infra side: we can emit three low-cardinality metrics: model_instance_count, prefix_cache_hit_rate, route_fallback_rate. Aggregated versions are safe for customers if we don't attach host identifiers.
Alejandra: For access control: propose roles = org-admin, dev, billing, auditor. Each role maps to a view set. Auditor needs read-only logs/audit trail. Any PII concerns for telemetry?
Nikhil: Audit logs must never contain raw prompt text. We can keep request_id, model, latency_ms, decision_reason (like `fallback:capacity`) and tenant_id. That satisfies compliance and still helps debugging.
Marisa: Product also wants shareable read-only links so customers can share dashboards with partners. How do we do time-limited shares without exposing API keys?
Elena: Mechanism: console-backend mints signed, time-limited tokens tied to a dashboard id + allowed panels. Implementation: `POST /dashboards/{id}/share` -> returns token and URL. Backend stores a `shared_dashboard` row with scope, creator_id, expires_at.
Sam: Dev note: token schema should be scoped to `read:view` and include an allow-list of panels. Avoid granting query API access. Example response: ```json
{
  "token": "<signed>",
  "scope": "read:view",
  "panels": ["infra","routing"],
  "expires": "2026-03-25T12:00:00Z"
}
```
Alejandra: Add share events to the audit log: who created, when, audience (if provided). Also need ability to revoke.
deploy-bot: Deployed console-share-service v1.2 to staging. Basic tests passed. :rocket:
Devin: Telemetry labels: include `model_variant` and `routing_policy` as optional tags so dashboards can segment by variant/policy. Caveat: increases cardinality. Suggest sampling detailed tags (1–5%) and always emit aggregated counts.
Marisa: Summarizing proposal: 1) emit infra metrics + route_fallback_rate; 2) optional sampled labels for fine-grained segments; 3) role-mapped views in console; 4) signed, time-limited share links (no API keys); 5) audit share events and revocation. Can one of you draft an RFC?
Sam: I'll start an RFC draft in `docs/rfcs/dashboard-sharing.md` and outline the metrics schema and token design. Will ping infra for metric names/stats.
Alejandra: I'll add a GDPR/PII checklist and audit requirements to the RFC.
Marisa: Can we sync Thurs 11am to finalize scopes and rollout plan? @Sam @Devin @Alejandra @Nikhil @Elena
Nikhil: I'm in.
Sam: Confirmed.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created for 2026-03-25 11:00.
Marisa: Thanks all — if you see any blockers, drop here.
